title.narrative: Trust Fund Management and Secretarial Support to the Southeast Asia Energy Transition Partnership (ETP)

description.narrative: The South East Asia Energy Transition Partnership (ETP), involves the ETP as a multi-donor fund established in 2019 with the overall aim to consolidate international support for the energy transition in South-East Asia in line with the Paris Agreement climate goals, and help creating the right policy, investment and infrastructure enabling environment to increase the deployment of renewable energy and energy efficiency in the region. \n\nThe United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) is engaged to offer Secretarial Support and to act as the Fund Manager, to administer the funds and provide monitoring and oversight.
